li.label: The Old Dream on a Moonlit Night
li.description: Just like that night a few years ago My family, my friends, my companions It seems like they have never left.

li.label: The expectation of returning home
li.description: I haven't been home for a long time. Will they be worried about me during the days I'm away?

li.label: The obsession of returning home
li.description: I haven't been home for too long. The scent of my hometown, the voice of my loved ones, the warmth of my home, I have been away for too long

li.label: The long cherished wish of returning home
li.description: I used to not understand what it meant to leave my hometown, until more than ten years have passed and I finally understand how heavy it is to leave.\n\nI have gained a lot in these ten years, but I have never been able to find my hazy past and memories again.

li.label: Memories of the past
li.description: Just like in the past, people would light fireplaces in blizzards, and the warm yellow flames would light up the entire town, making people feel cold even in the snow.

li.label: Memories of the past
li.description: The heavy snow outside the window, the heater inside the house, the father busy stealing fruit wine, and the mother chasing after him after smelling the aroma of wine When I was a child, I always loved snowy days like that.

li.label: Memories of the past
li.description: In the past heavy snow days, those snow dogs in the town always had extra excitement. Will they still be happy because of the snow now?

li.label: Memories of the past
li.description: This kind of wind and snow always reminds me of those days when I was a child unconsciously. Standing at the entrance of the town, waiting for my father to return with his prey.

li.label: Memories of the past
li.description: I remember during those snowy days, the nun would always pray for the townspeople who couldn't return home in time.\nIs she doing well now with such kindness?

li.label: Memories of the past
li.description: Why isn't everyone here? I've already come back On such a snowy day, everyone should be in the town...

li.label: Memories of the past
li.description: I always unconsciously think that the town is still the same as before, as if as soon as I step out of the door, I will see everyone still in the town.

li.label: Memories of the past
li.description: Will everyone come back? Just like in the past, we chased and played along the small paths in the town in the wind and snow together...\nI haven't had enough days like that yet...

li.label: Past Reconciliation
li.description: Perhaps I should not continue to be so destitute. Those happiness should not be the chains that bind me now, perhaps I should seek my true future.

li.label: The tenderness of the past
li.description: The memories of the past are no longer the shackles that trouble me, they will become the bonfire in my heart, accompanying me to continue moving forward in the snowstorm.

li.label: Eternal memories
li.description: I once lost a lot in pursuit of the past. And now I will no longer be confused by the past.\n\nThe past that I can't go back to will make me cherish everything I already have even more, and support me in my heart to get through the next tomorrow.
